scope: Saved-list priority, one candidate per configured SSID with directed fallback for invisible/hidden networks, next candidate on disconnect failure, ten-second rescan; unchanged ct39 application controls
limitations: Real first-network directed connection failed with reason 201 (NO_AP_FOUND); fallback to second network passed. Authentication-failure and active-link-loss failover not induced
All configured SSIDs attempted in saved order, including directed attempts for networks absent from broadcast scan; RSSI selects a radio only within one SSID
Initial network startup still has a 60-second total wait; Wi-Fi link failure triggers next candidate, no separate Internet-health failover
No physical power-cut, portal-edit persistence, spoken voice or actuator test
